components.name: Launch button
components.description: Inherited launch action, including hover, disabled and native keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-launch { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:var(--fs-sm); font-weight:var(--weight-medium); letter-spacing:var(--tracking-caps); color:var(--bg-window); background:var(--action-fill); border:none; border-radius:6px; padding:8px 16px; cursor:pointer; transition:opacity .12s ease-out; } .ds-launch:hover:not(:disabled) { opacity:.9; } .ds-launch:disabled { opacity:.4; cursor:default; } .ds-launch:focus-visible { outline:auto; }

components.name: Ghost button
components.description: Inherited secondary modal action with native keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-ghost { font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:var(--fs-xs); letter-spacing:var(--tracking-wide); color:var(--text-mid); background:transparent; border:1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius:6px; padding:8px 14px; cursor:pointer; transition:border-color .12s ease-out,color .12s ease-out; } .ds-ghost:hover { border-color:var(--text-low); color:var(--text-hi); } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline:auto; }

components.name: Repository field
components.description: Inherited text field for a machine-readable path; the displayed path is illustrative.
components.css: .ds-input { background:var(--bg-window); border:1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius:6px; color:var(--text-hi); font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:var(--fs-base); padding:9px 11px; outline:none; transition:border-color .12s ease-out; width:100%; } .ds-input:focus,.ds-input:focus-visible { border-color:var(--action); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--text-ghost); } .ds-input.ds-invalid { border-color:var(--red); }

components.name: Preset card
components.description: Reusable lineup card; this example uses illustrative saved-preset content.
components.css: .ds-preset { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; width:100%; min-height:82px; padding:13px; text-align:left; font-family:var(--font-sans); color:var(--text-hi); background:var(--bg-window); border:1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius:8px; cursor:pointer; transition:background 150ms ease-out,border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-preset-title { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; font-size:var(--fs-base); font-weight:var(--weight-medium); } .ds-preset-title svg { flex-shrink:0; color:var(--text-mid); } .ds-preset-count { margin-left:auto; color:var(--text-mid); font:var(--fs-xs) var(--font-mono); } .ds-preset-description { color:var(--text-mid); font-size:var(--fs-sm); line-height:1.4; overflow-wrap:anywhere; } .ds-preset:hover:not(:disabled) { background:var(--bg-hover); border-color:var(--text-low); } .ds-preset[aria-pressed="true"],.ds-preset[aria-pressed="true"]:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color:var(--action); background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--action) 10%,var(--bg-window)); } .ds-preset:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--action); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-preset:disabled { color:var(--text-low); cursor:default; }

components.name: Session count
components.description: Tabular count with the common launcher selected state.
components.css: .ds-count { display:grid; place-items:center; min-width:40px; height:40px; padding:0 10px; background:var(--bg-window); border:1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius:7px; font:var(--weight-medium) var(--fs-base) var(--font-sans); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:var(--text-hi); cursor:pointer; transition:border-color 150ms ease-out,background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-count:hover:not(:disabled) { background:var(--bg-hover); border-color:var(--text-low); } .ds-count[aria-checked="true"],.ds-count[aria-checked="true"]:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color:var(--action); background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--action) 10%,var(--bg-window)); } .ds-count:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--action); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-count:disabled { color:var(--text-low); cursor:default; }

components.name: Numbered session
components.description: Native provider select with a whole-seat focus treatment and the existing OpenCode SVG mark.
components.html: 1
components.css: .ds-seat { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-width:0; min-height:40px; padding:0 10px; background:var(--bg-window); border-radius:6px; } .ds-seat-number { color:var(--text-mid); font:var(--fs-xs) var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-agent-logo { color:var(--kind-color,var(--action)); flex-shrink:0; display:block; } .ds-seat select { width:100%; min-width:0; padding:11px 0; border:0; border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:var(--text-hi); font:var(--fs-base) var(--font-sans); appearance:none; cursor:pointer; } .ds-seat select option { color:var(--text-hi); background:var(--bg-window); } .ds-chevron { color:var(--text-mid); flex-shrink:0; pointer-events:none; } .ds-seat:focus-within { outline:2px solid var(--action); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-seat select:focus,.ds-seat select:focus-visible { outline:none; }

narrative.overview:
This scoped record describes the finished New Workspace extension and the modal primitives it reuses. It inherits flock’s established desktop world: Outfit labels, IBM Plex Mono machine details, theme-aware selection outlines, restrained borders and official provider marks. It does not establish a new app-wide identity.

The authority is the shipped [launcher stylesheet](../../../apps/flock-desktop/src/styles/newWorkspace.css), [shared dialog stylesheet](../../../apps/flock-desktop/src/styles/spawnDialog.css) and [global theme](../../../apps/flock-desktop/src/styles/global.css), with behavior in [NewWorkspaceDialog.tsx](../../../apps/flock-desktop/src/components/NewWorkspaceDialog.tsx). [PRODUCT.md](PRODUCT.md) records the confirmed product scope; the [surface brief](../../../.impeccable/surfaces/lock-desktop-src-components-newworkspacedialog-tsx.md) owns the task sequence and reference. Frontmatter colors are the inherited Nightfall baseline, not a replacement theme. Runtime global tokens, theme overrides and UI scaling remain authoritative. The sidecar’s generated tonal ramps are panel previews, not additional runtime tokens.
keyCharacteristics: Compact, readable controls within the incumbent modal frame.
Shared selection treatment across lineup choices.
Numbered sessions with visible individual editing.

rules.name: The Shared Selection Rule
rules.body: Presets, provider choices, counts and isolation choices use the active theme’s action border and a 10% action mix over the window ground. Provider identity stays in its official mark.

rules.name: The Reading Roles Rule
rules.body: Use sans for choices, including session-count buttons, and explanations; use mono for paths, refs, preset count metadata and session numbers. Inherit the app’s type scale and UI-size setting.

dos: Do bind color and type to the existing global tokens and theme overrides.
Do keep the shared selection treatment and visible keyboard focus across launcher choices.
Do preserve readable labels through wrapping grids and the independently scrolling body.
donts: Don't promote this launcher’s composition into a global layout rule.
Don't introduce new palette values or substitute provider identity for the common selection accent.
